pair.title: Pair a server
pair.alreadyPaired: This device is already paired with {{server}}:
pair.onlyOnce: A device can only be paired once with each server. To pair it as someone else, leave {{server}} in its settings first, then pair again.
pair.howTo: Join a server using Tidings and run /tidings pair.
pair.scanHelp: Point the camera at the map you got with /tidings pair
pair.codeHowTo: In game, run /tidings pair code to see the server's address and a code.
pair.notPairingQr: This QR code isn't a Tidings pairing code.
pair.cameraDenied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings, or use a pairing code.
pair.cameraError: Couldn't start the camera. Use a pairing code instead.
pair.approveInGame: Approve this device in game to pair it with {{server}}:
pair.approveHelp: Click [Approve] in the chat. You need to be connected to the server.
pair.denied: The pairing was denied in game. Run /tidings pair to get a new code.
pair.expired: The pairing request expired. Run /tidings pair in game to get a new code.
pair.playerOffline: {{player}} isn't connected to the server, so no one could approve this device. Join the server, run /tidings pair and try again.
